name: starryear-ink
title_zh: 照片留一条证据带，碎成干印再晕成水墨
tagline_zh: 不整幅糊成水墨，而是保留原图证据带，把画面碎成干涸印刷记忆，再晕出源图色相的彩色残像。适合做编辑感摄影印刷转译。
tagline_en: Not a full-frame ink filter. Keeps a source-photo evidence band, fractures the scene into dry print memory, then.
desc_en: Transform one user-supplied photograph into a vertical Starryear-Ink artwork that keeps a direct source-photo evidence band, fractures the scene into dry printed memory, and releases it as a source-bound chromatic ink afterimage. Use for Starryear-Ink, 星年水墨, 鹅鹅鹅, 摄影印刷水墨转译, or requests for a photo-to-print-to-ink editorial sheet. Do not use for full-frame ink filters, traditional shanshui, generic
why_zh: 证据带锁住真实，干印碎形切断柔焦惯性，色相残像从源图反推——三层机制让每张输出都是可核验的转译。
why_en: Evidence band anchors truth, dry-print fracturing breaks soft-focus habits, chromatic afterimage derives from source hues—three.
limit_zh: 只接受单张竖幅照片，横图或组图会直接停。不做全幅水墨滤镜，也不仿传统山水。产物是编辑感印墨版面，不是可打印的高清原图。
limit_en: Single vertical photo only; horizontal or batches stop. No full-frame ink filters or traditional shanshui. Output is an editorial print-ink sheet.
title_en: Photo keeps an evidence strip, fractures into dry ink.
